description: Replace the constructor with a seeded jitter-annealing search: random start, SLSQP local solve on (centers, radii), LP radius polish for exact feasibility, then 8 restarts from the best packing with Gaussian noise whose std decays geometrically from 0.05 to 1e-4, keeping the best.

Add a radius-weighted force-directed relaxation (pairwise repulsion scaled by radius sum, wall push, decaying damping, LP radii refreshed periodically) before each local optimisation, so the SLSQP and LP stage start from a more spread-out packing.
Change the jitter-anneal perturbation schedule so sigma decays from 0.1 to 0.002 over 20 accept-only-if-better rounds (fixed seed), instead of 0.05 to 1e-4 over 8 rounds.

Replace the random start of the jitter-anneal search with a Lubachevsky-Stillinger style growth pass (radii grow with a decaying rate and overlapping centers are pushed apart along their line of centers), then keep the existing SLSQP and LP polish.

Give SLSQP in _local_opt an analytic, vectorised Jacobian for its pairwise-overlap and boundary constraints (instead of finite differences), so each local solve is much cheaper and more iterations fit in the time budget.

Skipped: the LP-optimal radii for fixed centers idea is already in train.py as _lp_radii (same variables, border bounds, pairwise r_i + r_j <= d_ij, linprog HiGHS, maximise sum r), and _local_opt already uses it on every candidate.

Before the free-radii SLSQP in _local_opt, run an equal-radius SLSQP (maximise a shared radius s with x, y and s as variables) and use its centres as the warm start, keeping the original start as a candidate so the LP-polished best of both phases is returned.

issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. The candidate reruns the existing jitter_anneal_search with different seeds (12345 + 7919*k) inside a 200 s budget and keeps the best packing that passes a strict check. That is a real compute-for-quality trade.

_valid_packing correctly checks containment and pairwise overlap in double precision with zero tolerance. A packing that passes it should also pass the harness check, apart from rounding in how the distance is computed. It is not a bug, and the harness checks validity again anyway.

Wall-time risk: the budget passed to jitter_anneal_search is only checked at the start of each of its K iterations, and _ls_growth runs before the first check. One restart can therefore run past its nominal budget. The total is 200 s plus at most one overrunning iteration per restart, which should stay under 300 s if one iteration is short. Worth confirming the measured runtime of this job, because a timeout costs a whole slot.
Reproducibility: how many restarts run depends on the clock, so the result can vary between identical runs, depending on whether a later seed finishes in time. This is acceptable but should be noted.

Statistics: the candidate had 1 run and the incumbent had 1 run. No variance can be estimated from these numbers, so I cannot recompute z. The reported z = 1625.8 implies an assumed SD of about 1.4e-6, which looks like the noise floor of about 1e-6. The difference of 0.0023 (2.6317 vs 2.6294) is far above that floor, so accepting is reasonable. Still, 'z' rests on an assumed noise level rather than measured spread, and the gain could partly come from luck in which seeds get to run.

description: Wrap the jitter-anneal search in a time-budgeted restart loop (about 200 s total, first run keeps the 150 s budget, later restarts use the remaining time with new seeds) that tracks the best packing, re-verifies it in double precision, and falls back to the best valid one.

Add a jittered-grid "graded" start (the 26 grid points nearest the centre, so the layout is densest in the middle) as an alternative to the LS start, used only on odd restarts so the seed-0 path and incumbent are unchanged.

Each jitter-anneal step runs the local optimiser on an objective whose radii are weighted by a fixed-seed uniform(0.8, 1.2) factor per circle, while candidates are still scored by the true unweighted LP sum, so the best packing is kept.

Add a remove-and-reinsert polish stage after the restart loop: repeatedly take the smallest-radius circle of the current best packing, reinsert it at the grid point with the most clearance, re-optimise with _local_opt, and keep the result only if the sum improves and validates, until a fixed deadline.

Add a 180-degree rotationally symmetric start (13 free centres mirrored to (1-x, 1-y), shared radius per pair, optimised by SLSQP), then run the existing LP and unconstrained polish on it, and keep it as a candidate beside the LS start in jitter_anneal_search.

Adds a greedy hole-filling constructor that places circles one at a time at the grid point with the most clearance, re-solving the LP radii after each insertion, and uses it as the start for every second jitter-anneal restart, with the existing local optimiser as the final polish.

Add a penalty-relaxation stage (L-BFGS-B on centres and radii, mu geometric from 10 to 1e6 with warm starts) that refines each Lubachevsky-Stillinger start before the SLSQP local optimiser; feasibility is restored by the existing LP radii step.

Adds an Adam-minimised softplus overlap energy (radii as variables, minus their sum, beta annealed 20→2000, lr 0.01→1e-4, analytic gradients) as an extra start candidate in _local_opt, so the existing LP radius polish picks whichever centre set scores best.

issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. The new _mirror_opt builds a mirror-symmetric start from the existing centres, then uses the script's own _adam_soft and _local_opt to optimise it. Its result is only used if _valid_packing accepts it and its sum is strictly higher.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. A folded centre at exactly x = 0.5 would sit on top of its mirror copy, but the penalty relaxation should push them apart, and the validity check guards the result either way.

Run time: the mirror step (800 Adam iterations plus one _local_opt) runs before the time-budgeted loop. If budget=150.0 is counted from inside the loop and not from the start of the function, total time grows a little. It should still fit within about 4 minutes, but check it.

The numbers support the rejection. Candidate -2.6359 equals the incumbent mean of -2.6359, so there is no improvement. With one run on each side there is no variance estimate; the difference is 0, so z = 0, as reported. Reject is the right call.

description: Adds a mirror-symmetric start (13 centres folded into the left half and reflected across x = 0.5), relaxed with the Adam penalty solver and polished by _local_opt, and keeps it in jitter_anneal_search only if its sum beats the LS-growth start.

Adds a perturbed-lattice start (5x6 grid, 4 random points dropped to leave 26, jitter amplitude cycled over 0.01 to 0.1 across restarts) for restarts k>=1, keeping the LS-growth start for k=0, and keeps the best valid packing as before.
Considered a successive-halving batch (40 short seeded local optimisations, keep the top 5 for full convergence), and decided not to spend a slot on it.
Aborted: joint SLSQP over centers and radii already exists in _local_opt, and the analytic-Jacobian variant was already tested in slot 4 and rejected (+0.0170).

Add a ring-and-corner structured start (4 corners, 8 edge circles, two interior rings and a centre circle) and use it for every other restart in run_packing, alternating with the existing lattice start.

Add a time-bounded log-barrier polish after the remove-and-reinsert stage: from the best feasible packing, minimise minus the sum of radii minus (1/t) times the log slacks with L-BFGS-B while t grows tenfold per stage, then keep the result only if it passes the exact validity check and beats the incumbent sum.
Aborted the proposed LP-scored simulated annealing over center coordinates: the incumbent already reaches about 2.636, past the 2.635 best known, and the expected gain is within run-to-run noise.

Aborted the basin-hopping idea: it would largely duplicate the existing remove-and-reinsert polish and jitter-anneal loop, and the incumbent (-2.6360) is already at the best known value, so the expected gain is about zero.
Abort the multi-start-with-fixed-seed idea: train.py already runs a seeded multi-start loop (seeds 12345 + 7919k) under a time budget and keeps the best valid packing.

Add a hexagonal-lattice start (random spacing, orientation and offset, keep points in the square, drop the most crowded points until 26 remain) and use it for restart k=1 in place of the square-grid start, so the local optimiser runs from a different basin.

Skipped the active-set Newton refinement: the current packing already has its radii set exactly by the LP and a 1e-12 SLSQP KKT solve, so tangency sharpening can only gain roughly 1e-8, below the acceptance threshold and the noise floor.

Adds an elite pool (top 6 distinct packings) inside jitter_anneal_search and, on every second step, replaces the jitter perturbation with a line-cut crossover child of two pool members (count fixed to 26), followed by the usual _local_opt and pool insertion.

Split _adam_soft into four cosine-style cycles that each run the existing Adam softplus energy (lr 0.01 to 1e-4, beta 20 to 2000 within the cycle), restart from the previous cycle's centres perturbed by Gaussian noise (sigma 0.005), and keep the cycle candidate with the largest LP radius sum.

Adds a wall-slide move to _reinsert_polish that alternates with remove-and-reinsert, sliding a wall-touching circle to a random position along its wall, and keeps only strict sum improvements that pass _valid_packing.

Boundary-weighted random starts: in _ls_growth, about 40 percent of the initial centres are redrawn from a Beta(0.5, 0.5) distribution on each coordinate, concentrating them near the walls and corners, with the rest uniform in (0.1, 0.9), all from the seeded rng.

Adds a seeded, digit-scrambled van der Corput (Halton bases 2 and 3) start mapped into [0.05, 0.95]^2 and runs it through _local_opt as an extra candidate in jitter_anneal_search, keeping the better of it and the existing start.

issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. There is no file or network access, no pasted coordinates and no use of labels. The new _trust_polish stage refines the packing the script itself found. It recomputes the radii from the polished centres with _lp_radii, and keeps the result only if _valid_packing passes and the sum actually goes up. So it cannot make the output invalid or worse.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The constraints are correct: each pair's squared distance minus the squared sum of radii must be at least 0, and each circle must sit inside all four walls (bounds of 0 to 1 for the centres, 0 to 0.5 for the radii). The callback stops trust-constr once the 240 s deadline passes, and any exception falls back to the incumbent packing.

Timing risk (minor): the deadline is checked only between iterations. With '2-point' finite differences over 78 variables and 377 constraints, one iteration can run past 240 s. There is still a margin of about 60 s before the 300 s kill, so this is probably fine.
Cost: the polish gets its time by cutting _reinsert_polish from 235 s to 215 s. The candidate scores -2.636, exactly the incumbent's -2.6360, so the change gives no measurable gain.

Statistics: there is one run on each side and the difference is 0, so z = 0. No variance can be estimated from these numbers. Rejecting is consistent with the numbers. The submission makes no claims that contradict them.

description: Adds a time-bounded trust-constr polish after the reinsert stage on the joint centres and radii (same constraints as _local_opt), keeps the result only if its LP radii beat the incumbent and pass _valid_packing; the reinsert deadline moves from 235 s to 215 s to keep the run near 4 minutes.

Add a multi-start Adam stage before the reinsert polish: run _adam_soft from four seeded lattice starts (varying amplitude) and two noisy copies of the best centres, keep the top 3 by LP sum, pass each to _local_opt, and accept the result only if it beats the incumbent, with a deadline capping the stage.

Add a trust-region sequential LP (_trust_slp, 50 iterations, linearised pair and border constraints in (dx, dy, dr) with a box trust region) and feed its result into the candidate comparison at the end of _local_opt.

Adds a remove-from-27 candidate start: jointly optimise 27 random-start circles (SLSQP on centres and radii), drop the circle whose removal gives the largest LP-optimal sum of radii, then run _local_opt on the remaining 26 and keep it only if it beats the existing start inside jitter_anneal_search.

Adds an augmented-Lagrangian polish (_auglag_polish, 8 outer steps of L-BFGS-B with analytic gradients on centres and radii, multipliers and mu doubling to 1e4) after the remove-and-reinsert stage, keeping the result only if _valid_packing passes and the LP-scored sum improves.

Replace the jitter-anneal loop in jitter_anneal_search with a seeded full-covariance CMA-ES (population 12, sigma0 0.05) over the 52 centre coordinates, scored only by the LP radii sum, keeping the best 3 centre sets and polishing the best once with _local_opt.

Adds a seeded differential-evolution stage (rand/1/bin, F=0.6, CR=0.9, population 40, about 60 s) over the 52 centre coordinates scored by -sum(_lp_radii), seeded from the best centres, Gaussian perturbations and lattice starts; the top 3 individuals then go through _local_opt, and the restart budget drops from 200 s to 140 s to keep the run inside the wall-time limit.

Row-count layout starts (horizontal rows with alternating half-row offsets and seeded jitter, cycled through restarts) would be a near-duplicate of the perturbed-lattice and hex starts already tested in slots 15, 19 and 24, which gave 0.0000 to +0.0004 against the 2.6360 incumbent, so I am not spending a slot on it.

No bug found that would make the result meaningless. The lattice has 49 points, each quadrant takes its 7 or 6 points nearest the centre, scaled by 0.17 and rotated 90 degrees per quadrant, and 7+6+7+6 = 26. The points are clipped to the unit square. The pinwheel start replaces only restart k == 2, which is a legitimate change to the search, and the time budget is untouched.
The numbers support rejecting. Candidate and incumbent both score -2.636, so the difference is 0 and z = 0 (one run each, so no variance estimate). This change brings no measurable improvement.

Side note, not a problem with this diff: both scores round to 2.636, slightly above the best known 2.635. That is presumably rounding of a value near 2.6359. The harness checks validity with zero tolerance, so the score is not in doubt.

description: Adds a seeded pinwheel start: four quadrant triangular-lattice patches (7, 6, 7, 6 circles, each rotated 90 degrees from its neighbour), jittered and clipped, used as the start for restart k=2 only.

Adds seeded stochastic gradient Langevin noise to the centre coordinates in _adam_soft (std sqrt(2*T*lr), T decaying geometrically from 1e-3 to 1e-7), with the seed passed from jitter_anneal_search through _local_opt.
Abort the diagonal-reflection symmetric start: it is another symmetric seed of the same kind as slots 10 and 14, which gave +0.0004 and 0.0000, and the restart loop already covers diversity.

Abort the container-compression continuation: it is a penalty relaxation with a shrinking box, essentially the same mechanism as the rejected slot-12 penalty stage, and the incumbent has shown no gain for 19 slots.

Add a dual-guided relocation move to _reinsert_polish: LP duals pick one of the three least-constrained circles (seeded draw) on alternate steps, which is then moved to the largest-clearance grid point and accepted only on a strict improvement.
Add-to-25 insertion start: optimise 25 circles, insert a 26th at the largest-clearance grid point, and compare the best of three such packings in run_packing.

Adds a linearly decaying radius-variance reward (lambda from 0.05 to 0) to the Adam softplus energy in _adam_soft, with its gradient added analytically to the radius gradient, to push the optimiser away from near-equal symmetric basins.

Replace the single Adam softplus chain used in _local_opt with four replica-exchange chains at fixed softplus betas (50, 200, 800, 3000), with Metropolis swaps between adjacent replicas every 100 iterations, and return the lowest-beta replica as the candidate.

issues: No attempt to get around the measurement: the diff reads no files, pastes no coordinates and uses no labels. It only adds a short tabu memory to the existing loop that moves one circle and re-optimises.

No bug that would invalidate the result. Every accepted packing still goes through _valid_packing, and the loop still stops at the same deadline. Tabu entries expire after 12 iterations and are cleared on each improvement. If every grid cell is blocked, the code falls back to the unmasked clearance and then requires a gain of more than 1e-6 to accept.

Minor: the tabu filter rebuilds a Python list and loops over its entries on every iteration, which costs a little time. It also blocks only cells that circle i itself tried before. Neither affects correctness.
Candidate -2.636 equals incumbent -2.6360, so there is no improvement. The value sits right at the best known 2.635 (about 2.6359 unrounded), so it is plausible and not suspicious.

z: the difference is 0, so z = 0, matching the harness. With one run on each side the variance cannot really be estimated, so the test has almost no power. The provisional reject is consistent with the numbers.

description: Adds a tabu list to _reinsert_polish that blocks grid points within 0.04 of recently failed (circle index, cell) relocations for 12 iterations, with a 1e-6 aspiration threshold when a tabu cell must be used, leaving the deadline logic and _valid_packing check unchanged.

Aborted: a log-sum-exp smoothed max-min continuation would be a near-duplicate of polish stages already tested (log-barrier at slot 17, augmented Lagrangian at slot 29, trust-constr at slot 25), and the incumbent has been flat at -2.6360 for about 20 slots.

Adds a targeted perturbation to jitter_anneal_search: on a random half of the iterations only the four smallest circles are perturbed (Gaussian sigma times 5), and the other half keeps the existing uniform perturbation, with the same seeded generator and best-sum acceptance.

Inside _local_opt, the free-radii SLSQP becomes a three-stage continuation that caps radii at 0.12, then 0.25, then 0.5, with each stage warm-started from the previous output, before the existing LP polish and candidate comparison.

Replace the sequential restart loop with four ring-migrating islands (each with its own seed and jitter-anneal schedule, 12 s rounds split across islands, best-of-ring-neighbour migration when larger), keep a validated global best, and run _reinsert_polish on it.

Aborted the corner-anchored greedy-growth start: it is a near-duplicate of rejected starts (ring-and-corner at slot 16, graded at 7, Halton at 24, lattice at 15), and the incumbent has plateaued at -2.6360 for about 25 slots.

Aborted the two-class radius tying stage: it is a near-duplicate of the accepted equal-radius pre-stage (slot 5), and the incumbent has been flat for about 25 slots, so an extra seeded SLSQP stage per _local_opt call is unlikely to gain and would cut restart iterations within the 5-minute budget.

Adds a power-mean homotopy in _local_opt: SLSQP solves maximise sum(r^q) for q stepping 0.5 to 1.0 in five steps (r >= 1e-6), and the q=1 centres seed the existing free-radii SLSQP and join the LP candidate pool.

issues: No gaming found: _two_tier_start only builds seeded random starting positions with numpy (no file or network access, no pasted coordinates), and the result still goes through the optimiser and the strict validity check.

Harmless points: the small circles all start at radius 0.03 even where they don't fit, but only the starting layout uses this; on odd restarts amp is computed but not used; the new function sits under the misleading comment 'This part remains fixed (not evolved)'.
The numbers agree with 'reject': the candidate's sum of radii is 2.6338 against the incumbent's 2.6360, which is 0.0022 worse.

z can't be recomputed: there is only one run on each side, so the spread is unknown. The harness's z = -1519.268 means it used a noise level of about 1.45e-6 (0.0022 / 1519), close to the stated ~1e-6 run-to-run noise. With these numbers, z is very sensitive to that assumed noise level, but the candidate is clearly worse either way.

description: Adds a seeded two-tier start (3 to 5 fixed large circles with radii in [0.14, 0.20] placed by rejection sampling, then the rest inserted by greedy max-clearance on a grid) and uses it for odd-numbered restarts in run_packing, before the common _local_opt and reinsert stages.

Adds a pairwise centre-swap move to _reinsert_polish that runs when the remove-and-reinsert step fails: it swaps the centres of a random pair of circles whose radii differ by more than 0.03, re-runs _local_opt, and keeps the result only on a strict LP-sum improvement that passes _valid_packing.

Adds a seeded cyclic coordinate line search (_coord_line_search) that sweeps the 26 centres in random order, scores 25-point x and y grids within plus or minus 0.05 by the LP radii sum, and moves a centre when the sum increases; it runs for up to 15 s on the best jitter-anneal packing before the reinsert polish and is kept only if the packing passes the validity check.
Add a seeded Vogel (sunflower) spiral start with random rotation and jitter, used for every fifth restart (k % 5 == 4) in run_packing while other restarts are unchanged.

Aborted: a Levenberg-Marquardt polish on min(0, ·) overlap and boundary residuals would be another fixed-radius feasibility polish, and the existing joint SLSQP and LP-on-centres stages already reach this local optimum.

Adds a seeded quantised-centre escape move: every third restart, snap 6 random centres of the incumbent to a 0.02 grid with a small offset, re-optimise with _local_opt, and keep the result only if the LP sum improves.

Aborted the greedy decreasing-radius construction: it is a near-duplicate of the rejected greedy hole-filling constructor (slot 11, +0.0000), and the search has been flat at -2.6360 for about 40 slots, so it is not worth a slot.

Aborted the strip-decomposition start: horizontal rows with alternating half-offsets and seeded jitter were already tried (slot 32 row-count layout, slot 15 perturbed lattice), and the search has been flat for about 30 slots.

issues: No measurement circumvention: no file or network access, no pasted coordinates; the new subset polish only refines the script's own packing and re-validates it with _lp_radii and _valid_packing before accepting.

No result-voiding bugs found: the constraints (free-free, free-fixed, walls) are correct, the seed is fixed (2024), and the 235 s deadline leaves margin; a single SLSQP call may overrun the deadline slightly but should take well under a second.
Side effect: _reinsert_polish now gets 20 s less (215 s instead of 235 s).

Candidate -2.636 equals the incumbent mean -2.6360 (n=1 each). The difference is 0, so z=0 and reject is the right decision. With n=1 the variance can't be estimated, but a zero difference gives z=0 at any scale.
The sum of 2.636 is slightly above the quoted best known 2.635, consistent with rounding (best known is about 2.6359); the harness checked validity with zero tolerance.

description: Adds a seeded large-neighbourhood stage after the reinsert polish: repeatedly free a spatial cluster of 6 to 10 circles, hold the rest fixed as obstacles, re-optimise the free centres and radii with SLSQP, then accept the move only if the full-packing LP sum improves and _valid_packing passes.

Adds a Hessian-eigenvector saddle-escape stage after the restart loop: build the penalty Hessian by central differences of an analytic penalty gradient at the incumbent, then run seeded trials that perturb it along random combinations of the 3 to 5 lowest eigenvectors (norm 0.1, roughly 0.02 per circle) and re-optimise with _local_opt, keeping only valid improvements before the reinsert polish.
Radius-floor annealing in the Adam softplus energy (not run).
Abort the checkpoint-rewind idea: the restart loop in run_packing rarely reaches the four restarts needed for a rewind to trigger within the 200 s budget, so the change would be a no-op.
Abort: power-diagram Lloyd relaxation before each _local_opt call, not run.

Adds a seeded Gaussian-mixture clustered start (_cluster_start: 3 to 5 cluster centres in [0.2,0.8]^2, multinomial assignment of the 26 circles, per-cluster Gaussian scatter with sigma in [0.05,0.15], clipped to the square) that replaces the lattice start on every third restart (k % 3 == 0) in run_packing, passed directly to the existing _local_opt via jitter_anneal_search.

Aborted the contact-graph switching move: it is a perturb-then-reoptimise accept-if-better loop, which duplicates the existing remove-and-reinsert, centre-swap, wall-slide and basin-hopping moves that were already tried or aborted with no gain.

Adds a merge-and-split move to _reinsert_polish, run on every third attempt: merge the closest pair among the four smallest circles into one at their midpoint with area-equivalent radius, split the largest circle into two half-radius circles along the axis with more room, re-optimise with _local_opt, and keep the result only if the valid sum improves.

Aborted the adaptive per-circle pressure weights idea: it is a near-duplicate of slot 8, which already tested a weighted-radius objective inside the local optimiser (delta +0.0000), and the unweighted LP re-scoring it asks for is already how _local_opt picks its candidate.

Aborted the adaptive SLSQP iteration budget: rerunning SLSQP with maxiter=1000 on near-best candidates is unlikely to gain anything, since the 300-iteration solve already runs to ftol=1e-12 and the LP polish fixes the radii, and the extra solves would eat the fixed wall-time budget.
Abort the randomised-smoothing LP-gradient idea: its cost (about 66k LP solves for 40 steps) exceeds the time budget and the expected gain is near zero.

Aborted the seeded meta-grid over Adam schedules: it repeats the already-rejected Adam schedule variants (cosine cycles, slot 21; variance-reward schedule, slot 35), and an 18-run grid would consume a large share of the 200 s budget for little expected gain.

Aborted the LP dual sensitivity gradient ascent on centres: it is a local centre polish that duplicates the rejected trust-region SLP (slot 27) and the other post-optimisation polishes, which all gave 0 to +0.0001 on the incumbent.
Abort the radius reparametrisation (r = s^2) in _adam_soft: the Adam radii are discarded, so the change would only perturb the centre trajectory.

Replace the even restart loop in run_packing with a two-stage allocation: six seeded 20 s jitter-anneal searches ranked by sum of radii, then the top two continued from their best packings with the remaining time minus a 15 s reserve, keeping the reinsert polish and validity check unchanged.
Adds a seeded farthest-point (maximin) start, built from 2000 random candidates with a 0.01 jitter, and alternates it with the lattice start on odd restarts in run_packing.

Aborted: velocity-Verlet MD with a thermostat on the same softplus energy is a near-duplicate of the rejected Langevin-noise variant (slot 33) and the replica-exchange and Adam-cycle variants, so it is unlikely to beat the -2.6360 incumbent.

Adds an anisotropic affine shear basin-escape start (x+a*y, y*s with a in [-0.3,0.3], s in [0.85,1.15], refit to [0.02,0.98]^2) that the restart loop uses on every third restart, starting from the incumbent centres and accepted only through the existing best-so-far comparison.

Aborted: a reverse-beta re-annealing of _adam_soft from the incumbent is a near-duplicate of the rejected Adam cycle split (slot 21, +0.0022) and the Langevin and replica-exchange variants, so it is not worth a slot.

Adds a seeded sinusoidal warp of the incumbent centres (x += k*sin(pi*y)*amp, y += k*sin(pi*x)*amp, re-clipped to the square) as the restart start on every third restart, in place of the lattice start.
Abort the grow-from-20 insertion start: it duplicates the aborted add-to-25 insertion start (slot 35) and the rejected remove-from-27 start (slot 28), so no slot is spent on it.
Replace the Gaussian centre jitter in jitter_anneal_search with a seeded Mantegna Levy-stable step (tail index 1.5), scaled by the existing sigma schedule and clipped into the unit square.
Radius-ladder tiered start (aborted, not run): it is a near-duplicate of slot 42's seeded two-tier start, which was rejected at +0.0021, and of slot 7's graded start, which was rejected at +0.0004.

Adds a seeded quadrant-decomposition start used only for restart k=2: 26 circles split (7,6,7,6) in random order across four 0.5x0.5 quadrants, each quadrant's circles optimised as a small sub-packing in its own box, then the combined centres are handed to the existing _local_opt.
Aborted: the proposed contact-restricted trust-region LP repeats the rejected trust-region sequential LP from slot 27, which gave no gain.

Aborted the GP-surrogate restart-seed selection: it would pick at most one or two starts for the full pipeline within the 200 s budget, and the cheap LP proxy on raw centres is unlikely to rank starts usefully given that many start variants have gained 0 to +0.0017.
Aborted the Voronoi-vertex seeded start: it is a near-duplicate of rejected seeded starts (Halton, Vogel spiral, farthest-point), and the restart-start variants have been saturated at 0 to +0.0017.

Abort the Apollonian-style recursive corner-filling start: it is a near-duplicate of the greedy hole-filling constructor (slot 11, +0.0000) and the farthest-point maximin start (slot 55, -0.0000), and the start-construction family has been saturated at 0 to +0.0017 across many variants.

Abort the shell-by-shell radius profile prior: it is a near-duplicate of the rejected slot-35 annealed radius-variance reward in _adam_soft, and the Adam radii are discarded before the LP, so the prior can only steer centres during an annealing phase that is already saturated.
Skipped Hungarian-matched elite averaging: it is a near-duplicate of rejected elite-pool and seeded-start ideas, and it would compete for the time already used by the reinsert polish.

Adds a gravity-compaction start: a seeded Adam softplus pass from uniform random centres with a linearly decaying pull toward (0.5, 0.5), used as the alternative start for every third restart in run_packing.

Prune the pair constraints to centre distance below 0.35 at the start of _equal_opt, _local_opt and _adam_soft, keep full-pair LP radii and _valid_packing as the final check, and print the number of restarts completed to stderr. The mid-run pair rebuild after the first SLSQP batch is not implemented, so the pair set stays fixed per call.

With one run on each side the variance is undefined, so z cannot properly be computed. The raw difference is 0, which matches the harness's z = -0.000. Rejecting is right because there is no improvement.

description: Seed the Adam softplus energy in _adam_soft with power-law radii (k^-alpha, alpha seeded in [0.3, 0.8], max 0.2, permuted then assigned largest-to-closest-to-centre) instead of the LP radii, leaving the LP stage and everything else unchanged.

Add _aspect_detour, which sweeps the container from width 0.8 to 1.25 (height 1/w) over 6 warm-started SLSQP stages with free radii, maps the final centres back to the unit square, and feeds the result to _local_opt as an extra candidate scored by _lp_radii.
Aborted the logit-reparametrised L-BFGS polish: it is a near-duplicate of rejected penalty and barrier polishes (slots 17, 25, 29), which all gave 0 to +0.0001 on the same incumbent.

Aborted the Riesz-energy spreading start: it is a near-duplicate of rejected even-spread starts (farthest-point maximin, slot 55; gravity-compaction start, slot 62; Vogel spiral, slot 45), and the search has been saturated for about 40 slots.

Abort the random block coordinate descent idea: it duplicates the rejected large-neighbourhood stage (slot 47, which freed a spatial subset and re-optimised it), and the search has been saturated at -2.6360 for about 36 slots.
Aborted the Poisson-disk initial-centres idea without running it: a maximin spread start is already rejected (slot 55, 0 gain) and Halton, Vogel and hex starts all gave 0 to +0.0017.
Replace the softplus overlap and border penalties in _adam_soft with a Huber penalty whose gradient is clip(overlap, 0, delta), with delta decaying geometrically from 0.2 to 1e-3.
Aborted the index-permutation SLSQP restart idea: it is expected to be a no-op within replicate noise.

Aborted the randomised radius-cap ratchet: it is a near-duplicate of rejected SLSQP polish stages (slots 17, 25, 29, 39), and running 30 extra SLSQP solves inside _local_opt would multiply the cost of the many _local_opt calls and risk breaking the 5-minute wall-time limit.
Aborted: neighbour-list pruning of SLSQP pair constraints, a speed-only change to _local_opt that duplicates the rejected analytic-Jacobian speedup (slot 4).

Aborted: a dual_annealing pass over the 52 centre coordinates with LP fitness is a near-duplicate of the aborted LP-scored simulated annealing over centres (slot 18), and its roughly 60 s budget would crowd the existing 200 s restart loop and reinsert stage under the 5-minute limit.
Aborted the pairwise exchange local search: slot 43 already tried a pairwise centre-swap move scored by LP and gained +0.0000, so this would repeat a rejected idea.
Aborted radius-only basin hopping: perturbing radii before _lp_radii on fixed centres is a no-op because the LP depends only on the centres.

Before the free-radii SLSQP in _local_opt, a maximin LP (maximise the minimum radius t) is followed by a sum LP with every radius floored at 0.98t, and the resulting radii replace the plain LP warm start when they are valid.
UCB bandit over four restart start generators (LS growth, perturbed lattice, farthest-point maximin, incumbent with Gaussian kick), not run.

Raise the restart-loop budget to 225 s and the reinsert deadline to 245 s, and add a 6 s wall-clock guard to the jitter-anneal loop and the reinsert loop so no new local optimisation starts close to the deadline.
Replace the fixed 1e-10 LP shrink with an exact double-precision rescale of the packing, falling back to the old margin if _valid_packing fails.

Aborted the feasibility-pump stage: it is a penalty-based centre relaxation with LP radii, which duplicates the rejected penalty-relaxation (slot 12), Huber/softplus energy (slots 33, 66) and LP-alternation ideas, and it would add about 30 L-BFGS-B and LP rounds that push run_packing past its 235 s reinsert deadline.

Aborted: the soft-sphere ratio penalty would replace the overlap term inside _adam_soft, which is the same change slot 66 already tested (Huber replacement of the softplus penalties, +0.0053), and the search has been flat for about 36 slots.
Give each circle a seeded lognormal (sigma 0.5) growth multiplier in _ls_growth so radii grow at rate*m_i, keeping the push-apart loop, boundary clipping, and the first-restart-only start.

Aborted: random pair-term dropout in _adam_soft is gradient noise on the same energy, which is a near-duplicate of the rejected Langevin-noise (slot 33, +0.0022) and Levy-flight (slot 58, +0.0021) centre perturbations inside the same Adam loop.
Trust-region LP restricted to contact-graph pairs, called inside _reinsert_polish, was not run.
Aborted: rewriting compute_max_radii cannot change the score, because run_packing never calls construct_packing or compute_max_radii.

Aborted the exact-feasibility radius rescale: the fixed 1e-10 shrink costs at most about 26 x 1e-10 = 2.6e-9 in the sum of radii, far below the 4-decimal reporting resolution and run-to-run noise, so it cannot move the official score.
Skipped: simulated annealing over the 26 centres with LP-scored radii duplicates the previously aborted slot 18 idea and overlaps rejected basin-hopping and LP-fitness searches.

Aborted the fingerprint-cache idea without a slot: it only changes the perturbation schedule after repeated basins, which near-duplicates the rejected elite-pool, targeted-perturbation and Levy-jump ideas, and the incumbent already ignores non-improving candidates.

Aborted the threshold-accepting change: the acceptance rule would only alter a separate "current" record, while the returned packing, the reinsert polish start, and the restart starts all still depend only on the true best or on seeds, so the output would be unchanged.

Abort: the Apollonian-style recursive corner-filling start is a near-duplicate of starts already tried (greedy hole-filling in slot 11, farthest-point maximin in slot 55, and the rejected seeded starts), and this same idea was already aborted at slot 61.
Aborted the Levenberg-Marquardt overlap-residual polish: it is a near-duplicate of the rejected penalty, augmented-Lagrangian, log-barrier and trust-constr polish stages, which all gave 0 to +0.0001.

Abort the contact-graph switching move: it is a perturb-then-reoptimise, accept-if-better loop, which duplicates the already-aborted slot 51 and the existing jitter-anneal and remove-and-reinsert stages.

Aborted the exact-feasibility rescale: the fixed 1e-10 shrink costs only about 3e-9 in total sum of radii, so an exact rescale cannot measurably change the score, and the same idea was already aborted as slot 79.
Abort the fixed-seed multi-start idea: run_packing already runs a seeded multi-start restart loop (seeds 12345 + 7919*k, each with a time budget), and slot 18 aborted this same idea for that reason.

Aborted the centre-dilation line search: the incumbent is already a KKT point of the joint centre-and-radius problem, so a global scaling of the centres should give no first-order gain, and the LP step already optimises radii for fixed centres.
Abort the two-size checkerboard seed: its radii are discarded by _local_opt, so it reduces to another perturbed 6x5 lattice start, which the incumbent already uses.
Abort the decaying centre-spread bonus: it is a perturbation of the same free-radii SLSQP that tuned continuation and penalty ideas already tested, with a low expected gain.
Adds a seeded cosine-spaced 6x5 tensor-grid start (_cosine_grid_start, points crowded toward walls, 4 dropped at random, jitter 0.02) used for restarts with k % 3 == 2 in place of _lattice_start.

Adds stagnation-triggered sigma reheating to jitter_anneal_search: after 5 consecutive non-improving iterations, sigma resets to 0.05 and decays geometrically to 0.002 over the remaining iterations, keeping the seed, draws, K=20 and the time-budget check unchanged.
Aborted the successive-halving seed batch: it duplicates the seeded multi-start restart loop in run_packing and the rejected multi-start and UCB-bandit start selection (slots 26, 31, 70, 87).

Abort the polar-coordinate centre parametrisation of the Adam softplus energy, since it is a coordinate reparametrisation of the same energy that duplicates the rejected radius and logit reparametrisations.

Aborted the GP-surrogate restart-seed selection: slot 60 already rejected this idea as a near-duplicate, and the time budget allows only about two restarts, so a surrogate has almost nothing to choose between.
Aborted: active-set Newton refinement of the final packing, since the incumbent is already a KKT point and the expected gain is at most about 1e-9.
Aborted the add-to-25 insertion start: every seeded start variant tried so far has converged to the same basin (0 to +0.0017 gain), and this idea was already aborted twice as a near-duplicate.
Aborted: an exact double-precision rescale of the final radii duplicates slots 72, 79 and 86, which were already aborted.

Abort the rotate-and-refit kick: a rotation about the centre plus a shrink-and-clip restart seed is a near-duplicate of the already-rejected affine shear start (slot 56) and sinusoidal warp (slot 57), which also re-map the incumbent relative to the walls, and the search has been flat at -2.6360 for about 35 slots.

Plateau-drift acceptance in jitter_anneal_search: perturbations start from a separate current state that also moves to any candidate within 1e-7 of the best sum, while best_c, best_r and best_s still track only the strict maximum.

Aborted the position-tilted objective annealing: it is a close variant of slot 8's rejected weighted-objective jitter, and it ends on the unweighted objective, so it should reach the same local optimum with no expected gain.

Aborted the stress-guided perturbation: scaling the jitter kick by LP-dual stress would only reweight the same Gaussian centre kick in jitter_anneal_search, which slots 8, 38, 92 and 100 already tested as variants of perturbation shape and acceptance, all at 0 to +0.002.
Prescribed wall-contact counts as SLSQP equalities: fix a seeded wall-touching structure as equalities, solve, then release and re-run _local_opt.
Per-step displacement clip (d_t from 0.02 to 0.0005) on the Adam centre update in _adam_soft, not run.

Add a seeded cluster-reflection move to jitter_anneal_search that reflects the centres on one side of a random line across that line on about one iteration in four, alternating with the existing Gaussian jitter, and accepts by the usual LP-scored sum comparison.

Abort the toroidal periodic-start relaxation: it is another seeded start generator, and the same family (seeded starts, including gravity-compaction in slot 62 and perturbed-lattice in slot 15) has gained nothing over the incumbent.

Aborted the clearance-scaled perturbation: scaling each circle's kick by its LP radius is the same stress-guided kick already aborted at slot 102 and close to the rejected per-circle pressure-weight and targeted-perturbation variants, so it is unlikely to beat the incumbent -2.6360.

Evaluate the _adam_soft softplus gradient at a Nesterov look-ahead point (z minus the lagged Adam step, using the descent sign), keeping the bias-corrected second moment, annealed beta, learning-rate schedule and final clipping unchanged.

Adds a bisection-on-shared-radius warm start (_equal_bisect): 25 bisection steps on s in [0.05, 0.11], each an L-BFGS-B squared-overlap penalty minimisation over the 52 centre coordinates warm-started from the last feasible centres, and _local_opt uses it in place of the SLSQP equal-radius stage.

Adds a seeded Laplacian-eigenmap start (4-nearest-neighbour graph on random points, Fiedler-pair coordinates rescaled to [0.08, 0.92] with small jitter) used in place of the lattice start for restarts k=3 and k=7 only, so the restart count is unchanged.
Mirror-descent on log-radii inside _adam_soft (aborted, not run): its radii are discarded, so only the centre gradients would change.

Aborted: novelty-driven restart seeding is a farthest-point start selection, a near-duplicate of the rejected maximin start (slot 55) and the UCB start-selection idea (slot 70), and with the restart loop running only about two starts in 200 s the bank would hold at most one or two signatures, so it would barely change the k=1 start.

Give the radii in _adam_soft their own learning-rate schedule (0.003 decaying geometrically to 3e-5) while centres keep the existing 0.01 to 1e-4 schedule, applied through a per-coordinate lr vector each step.

Aborted the lattice-defect start: a hexagonal-patch seed with a vacancy and interstitial is a near-duplicate of the rejected hexagonal-lattice start (slot 19, +0.0000) and the other rejected structured seeds.

Replace the isotropic Gaussian centre kick in jitter_anneal_search with a seeded kick restricted to a random k-dimensional orthonormal subspace (k in 4 to 8), keeping the existing sigma schedule and the accept-if-better rule.

Abort the LP-screened start pool: it is a near-duplicate of rejected or aborted start-selection ideas (slot 93 successive-halving seed batch, slot 70 bandit over start generators), and it adds about 1500 LP solves plus 8 extra _local_opt runs that would take a large share of the restart budget.

Abort: alternating projections between overlap and wall sets is a penalty-style centre relaxation with fixed inflated radii, which duplicates the rejected penalty relaxation (slot 12) and the aborted feasibility-pump idea.
Aborted the jam-then-relax multiplicative-growth start: it is a near-duplicate of the existing _ls_growth start and of rejected seeded-start variants, and its growth schedule is ill-defined.

Aborted the data-driven radius prior: seeding _adam_soft with a rank-fitted radius profile from elite packings is a near-duplicate of slot 63 (power-law radii seed, rejected at +0.0000) and slot 20 (elite pool, rejected).
Abort: seeded hard-disk Monte Carlo compression start generator, not run.

Aborted the integer-lattice discrete local search: it is a coordinate-wise, LP-scored centre search, which duplicates the aborted LP-scored simulated annealing (slot 80), the dual-annealing LP fitness idea (slot 68) and the rejected coordinate line search (slot 44). Expected gain is zero.

Abort the superellipse container homotopy: it is a container-deformation start that duplicates slot 64's rejected aspect-ratio sweep, and its final p=2 stage describes a disk rather than the unit square, so it cannot yield a valid square packing as specified.
Aborted the LP-dual shrinking-target radius profile: it is a radius-weighted pre-solve in _local_opt, close to rejected slots 8, 39 and 69, and the search has been flat at -2.6360 for about 36 slots.
Rescale the free-radii SLSQP variables in _local_opt by s=0.1 (z=[x/s, y/s, r/s]) so coordinates and radii are O(1), with maxiter 500 and ftol 1e-14, then unscale before the LP candidate selection.

Abort the Hamiltonian-dynamics thermostat idea: velocity-Verlet MD with a thermostat on the same softplus energy duplicates aborted slot 56 and the rejected Langevin-noise and Nesterov variants of _adam_soft.

Aborted the rattler-freezing reduced SLSQP: it is a speed-only change to _local_opt, and the search has plateaued at -2.6360 across many slots, so freeing budget for extra restarts is unlikely to move the score.

Abort the row-count layout start: horizontal-row starts with alternating half-row offsets were already aborted (slots 32 and 47), and the perturbed-lattice start (slot 15) and hex-lattice start (slot 19) cover the same grid-like seed family with no gain.
Aborted the coarse-to-fine tolerance schedule: it is a speed-only change to fixed-length local solves, so it cannot improve the score.
Clip each centre update in _adam_soft to a geometrically decaying maximum displacement (0.02 to 0.0005), leaving the radii update and softplus energy unchanged.

Aborted the Riesz-energy spreading start: it repeats an idea already aborted in slot 65 and the same family of seeded even-spread starts (farthest-point, even-spread, Poisson-disk) that gave 0 to +0.0001 gain, so no slot is spent.
Aborted the LP dual sensitivity gradient ascent on centres without running it, since the incumbent is already a local optimum of the joint centre-and-radius problem.

Replace the Adam update in _adam_soft with a Lion-style sign-momentum step (momentum 0.9, step lr*sign(m)) plus decoupled 1e-4 decay on the radii, keeping the beta annealing, learning-rate decay and box clipping unchanged.
Aborted the checkpoint-rewind stagnation policy: the restart loop in run_packing cannot reach its trigger within the time budget, so the change would be a no-op.

Skipped the contact-count bonus in the free-radii SLSQP: a count of pairs below a gap threshold is piecewise constant, so its gradient is zero almost everywhere and the lambda pass would leave the SLSQP iterates unchanged.

Aborted: a 101-point largest-clearance insertion pass after _reinsert_polish duplicates the existing reinsert stage, which already removes the smallest circle and reinserts at the largest-clearance grid point.
Abort the two-stage hole screening: it is a candidate-ranking variant of _reinsert_polish that duplicates rejected slots 34, 37 and 135, and the incumbent has not moved in over 40 slots.
Refine the reinsertion point in _reinsert_polish with a Nelder-Mead search over the top 5 grid clearance points, then re-optimise with _local_opt under the same accept rule.

Abort: scaling each circle's jitter kick by its LP-radius slack duplicates slot 107's aborted clearance-scaled perturbation, and the perturbation-kick family has already yielded only regressions or zero change.
Add a local random-disc rotation kick to jitter_anneal_search, applied with probability 0.25 to the centres inside a random disc.

Replace the fixed geometric sigma schedule in jitter_anneal_search with a 1/5 success-rule controller (sliding window of 5 kicks, multiply sigma by 1.15 on success rate above 1/5 and by 0.87 otherwise, clamped to [0.002, 0.1]), keeping the seeded rng and time budget.
Replace the random 4-point drop in _lattice_start with a seeded greedy min-spacing drop rule from the 5x6 grid.
Aborted: two-stage hole screening in _reinsert_polish is a candidate-ranking variant of the reinsertion stage, which was already aborted as slot 136 and rejected in several close variants.

Aborted: a proximal-regularised free-radii SLSQP pass is a small perturbation of the existing SLSQP step in _local_opt, which has already been varied many times (trust-region, rescale, continuation and contact-count slots), so it is not worth a slot.
Aborted the time-split between restart search and reinsertion: it is a budget-allocation change that duplicates rejected slots 54 and 71, and it cannot be applied as specified.
Abort: prescribed wall-contact equalities duplicate slot 103, which was already aborted for this idea, and the incumbent's free-radii SLSQP already searches over wall contacts.

Abort: a seeded hard-disk Monte Carlo compression start generator is another start-seed variant, and this family has been tried and rejected repeatedly (slots 7, 14, 19, 24, 32, 45, 50, 55, 110), with gains of 0 to +0.0017 each.
Aborted: jam-then-relax multiplicative-growth start is a near-duplicate of the rejected seeded start variants and the existing LS growth start.

Aborted the corner-anchored greedy-growth start without running it: it is a near-duplicate of slot 41's aborted corner-anchored greedy-growth start and of the rejected greedy hole-filling constructor (slot 11) and ring-and-corner start (slot 16).

Aborted the power-diagram Lloyd relaxation: it is a centre-spreading pre-conditioner on the same SLSQP/_local_opt pipeline, a near-duplicate of rejected even-spread and maximin starts (slots 1, 55, 65, 130), and the search has been saturated for about 125 slots.
